title: Remote foundations D0: docs/features brief for the central TermAl control plane, satellites and cross-host mailboxes
outcome: Remote foundations D0: docs/features brief for the central TermAl control plane, satellites and cross-host mailboxes
acceptance: A new docs/features brief states the accepted design: central TermAl host + satellite hosts (hub-and-spoke, no mesh, no storage replication); the TermAl API over OpenSSH as the host-to-central protocol; one canonical mailbox store at the central host with a retry-only sender outbox, never a source for list/read/ACK; identity/enrollment/registry/capacity; onboarding verification; behaviour when the central host is unreachable; the M/L/O/P slice map; the Engram boundary sentence "TermAl mailboxes carry ordinary coordination only; they carry no task-sync protocol."
It is cross-linked both ways with docs/features/agent-mailboxes.md and docs/features/project-scoped-remotes.md, and those pages' 'planned remote access' text points to it without contradicting it.
It matches the concurred design text (joint-v7 once concurred) with no contradictions; an independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding; the docs-only full gate passes.
